reply.answer_text: I'm very sorry for your loss. For a trust-held whole of life policy, we don't need Confirmation (Scottish probate equivalent) — that's an advantage of the trust structure. We'll ask for: the certified death certificate, the trust deed, and trustee identification. Once we have those and confirm premiums are paid, death claims are typically settled within 5 working days. I'll take your details now, and we'll send you a single requirements letter so you're not chasing back and forth.
